headline: BAL @ LAA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BAL 4.69 at LAA 4.39, with a projected total of 9.08. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: BAL moved +0.51 runs while LAA moved +0.10, changing the projected margin by +0.41 runs. The projected total climbed +0.60, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +7.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Sam Aldegheri has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Denzer Guzman, Donovan Walton, Logan O'Hoppe, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Coby Mayo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
